pattern.description: The workday letters wipe in left to right from light to brand blue while 'Adaptive Planning' fades up beneath; the whole lockup then rises slightly as the orange arc sweeps on above it, its gradient settling from red/yellow to solid orange.
pattern.why_premium: Sequenced build (wordmark, product name, then signature arc) in brand colours on a clean white field gives a calm, confident open; the colour settle on the arc adds polish without extra motion.

build_hint.gsap: tl.fromTo('.wd-char', {clipPath: 'inset(0 100% 0 0)', color: '#7fb4ff'}, {clipPath: 'inset(0 0% 0 0)', color: '#0b3fa0', duration: 0.4, stagger: 0.05, ease: 'power2.out'}).fromTo('.ap', {autoAlpha: 0, y: 20}, {autoAlpha: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.4, ease: 'power2.out'}, '<0.1').to('.lockup', {y: -60, duration: 0.4, ease: 'power2.inOut'}, '+=0.05').fromTo('.arc path', {drawSVG: '50% 50%'}, {drawSVG: '0% 100%', duration: 0.5, ease: 'power3.out'}, '<0.1').to('.arc path', {stroke: '#f26b0f', duration: 0.4}, '<0.2').
build_hint.remotion: Per-char clip reveal: width = interpolate(frame - i*1.5, [0, 10], [0, 100], {extrapolateRight: 'clamp', easing: Easing.out(Easing.quad)}); subtitle opacity/translateY from spring({frame: frame - 8, fps, config: {damping: 200}}); lockup translateY via spring({frame: frame - 18, fps, config: {damping: 200}}) * -60; arc strokeDashoffset interpolated with Easing.out(Easing.cubic) over 12 frames from frame 20, stroke colour interpolateColors to orange.

notes: Letter-level boxes b07-b12 exist; the wordmark is annotated once via b02 to avoid overlap. The lockup's upward shift (to make room for the arc) is inferred from filmstrip positions; code should confirm. Arc reveal direction (from centre vs one end) is unclear from the frames. No SFX candidates.
